items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Bauvoranfrage
items.quote: Rechtsbehelf: Widerspruch. Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The letter is dated Mon 2 Mar 2026 and was sent by an authority by post, so under Section 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG it counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 6 Mar 2026. Under Section 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the day after delivery, so counting begins 7 Mar 2026. Under Section 188 Abs. 2 BGB one month later falls on Mon 6 Apr 2026. That day is Ostermontag (Easter Monday), a public holiday in Baden-Wuerttemberg, so under Section 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG the deadline shifts to the next business day, Tue 7 Apr 2026.

warnings: The Widerspruch deadline of 2026-04-07 has already passed as of today (2026-09-26); if the recipient still wants to challenge the decision they should seek legal advice on options such as Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand.
A separate fee notice (Gebuehrenbescheid) for this decision is announced but not yet issued, so no deadline for it can be set from this letter.

The signature block shows 'Im Auftrag / Lindqvist' while the header names 'Herr Lindqvist' as the contact for information (Auskunft erteilt) - worth double-checking that this letter is correctly addressed to the recipient.
